select count(distinct "account_id") as "count" from (
  select coalesce(l.id, -a.id) as id, a.nombre as nombre, a.tipo as tipo, a.subtipo as subtipo, a.ciudad as ciudad, l.estado as estado, coalesce(l.suscripcion,a.subscription_label) as suscripcion, a.email as email, a.telefono as telefono, a.sitio_web as sitio_web, a.url_gmap as url_gmap, a.perfil_instagram as perfil_instagram, a.perfil_facebook as perfil_facebook, a.perfil_airbnb as perfil_airbnb, a.perfil_booking as perfil_booking, a.perfil_turismo_entre_rios as perfil_turismo_entre_rios, coalesce(a.origin,l.origen) as origen, l.quien_cargo as quien_cargo, l.asignado_a as asignado_a, coalesce(l.fecha_creacion, a.created_at)::date as fecha_creacion, coalesce(lc.occurred_at,l.fecha_ultimo_contacto)::date as fecha_ultimo_contacto, l.medio_contacto_preferido as medio_contacto_preferido, l.resultado_ultimo_contacto as resultado_ultimo_contacto, l.prioridad as prioridad, nt.due_date as fecha_proxima_accion, coalesce(a.source_reference,l.fuente_referencia) as fuente_referencia, l.cliente_potencial_recurrente as cliente_potencial_recurrente, l.archivo_adjunto as archivo_adjunto, l.notas as notas, l.creado_por as creado_por, a.created_at as created_at, a.updated_at as updated_at, coalesce(pc.name,l.contact_name) as contact_name, a.deleted_at as deleted_at, l.deleted_by_user_id as deleted_by_user_id, l.deleted_by_email as deleted_by_email, l.deleted_by_name as deleted_by_name, a.assigned_user_email as assigned_user_email, l.commercial_profile as commercial_profile, a.id as account_id, l.opportunity_name as opportunity_name, l.primary_contact_id as primary_contact_id, l.service_interest as service_interest, l.estimated_close_date as estimated_close_date, l.assigned_at as assigned_at, l.contact_baseline_date as contact_baseline_date, l.contact_baseline_result as contact_baseline_result, l.stage_since as stage_since, l.pipeline_revision as pipeline_revision, l.reactivated_from_id as reactivated_from_id, l.creation_request_key as creation_request_key, l.creation_request_hash as creation_request_hash, l.management_type as management_type, l.referred_previous_stage as referred_previous_stage, l.referred_previous_assigned_user_email as referred_previous_assigned_user_email, a.whatsapp as whatsapp, pc.phone as contact_phone, pc.email as contact_email, a.status AS business_status
  from crm_accounts a
  left join leads l on l.account_id = a.id and l.deleted_at is null
  left join (select distinct on (c.account_id) c.account_id, c.name, c.phone, c.email from crm_contacts c where c.deleted_at is null order by c.account_id, c.is_primary desc, c.id) pc on pc.account_id = a.id
  left join (select t.account_id, min(t.due_date) as due_date from crm_tasks t left join leads tl on tl.id=t.lead_id where t.status='pending' and t.deleted_at is null and (t.lead_id is null or tl.deleted_at is null) group by t.account_id) nt on nt.account_id = a.id
  left join (SELECT account_id,max(at) AS occurred_at FROM (
  SELECT m.account_id,coalesce(m.last_interaction_at,m.created_at) AS at FROM crm_messages m LEFT JOIN leads ml ON ml.id=m.lead_id
   WHERE m.status=ANY($1::text[]) AND (m.lead_id IS NULL OR ml.deleted_at IS NULL)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.account_id,r.occurred_at AS at FROM crm_communication_responses r LEFT JOIN leads rl ON rl.id=r.lead_id WHERE r.lead_id IS NULL OR rl.deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i.account_id,i.received_at AS at FROM crm_inbound_messages i LEFT JOIN leads il ON il.id=i.lead_id WHERE i.status IN ('pending_review','registered') AND i.is_automatic=false AND (i.lead_id IS NULL OR il.deleted_at IS NULL)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.account_id,a.occurred_at AS at FROM crm_activities a LEFT JOIN leads al ON al.id=a.lead_id LEFT JOIN crm_messages am ON am.activity_id=a.id
   WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND (a.lead_id IS NULL OR al.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (
    (am.id IS NULL AND (a.outcome IS NULL OR a.outcome<>'no_answer')) OR (am.id IS NOT NULL AND am.status=ANY($2::text[]))
   )
 ) evidence GROUP BY account_id) lc on lc.account_id = a.id
  where a.merged_into_id is null and a.archived_at is null and ($3 or a.deleted_at is null)
) as "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and (fecha_ultimo_contacto IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_activities ac WHERE ac.deleted_at IS NULL AND (ac.lead_id=leads.id OR (ac.lead_id IS NULL AND ac.account_id=leads.account_id)))) = $4 and greatest(coalesce(fecha_ultimo_contacto,created_at),coalesce((select max(occurred_at) from crm_activities ac where (ac.lead_id=leads.id or (ac.lead_id is null and ac.account_id=leads.account_id)) and ac.deleted_at is null),created_at)) < $5 and "fecha_proxima_accion" < $6

  left join (SELECT account_id,max(at) AS occurred_at FROM (
  SELECT m.account_id,coalesce(m.last_interaction_at,m.created_at) AS at FROM crm_messages m LEFT JOIN leads ml ON ml.id=m.lead_id
   WHERE m.status=ANY($1::text[]) AND (m.lead_id IS NULL OR ml.deleted_at IS NULL)
  UNION ALL

  UNION ALL
  SELECT i.account_id,i.received_at AS at FROM crm_inbound_messages i LEFT JOIN leads il ON il.id=i.lead_id WHERE i.status IN ('pending_review','registered') AND i.is_automatic=false AND (i.lead_id IS NULL OR il.deleted_at IS NULL)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.account_id,a.occurred_at AS at FROM crm_activities a LEFT JOIN leads al ON al.id=a.lead_id LEFT JOIN crm_messages am ON am.activity_id=a.id
   WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND (a.lead_id IS NULL OR al.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (
    (am.id IS NULL AND (a.outcome IS NULL OR a.outcome<>'no_answer')) OR (am.id IS NOT NULL AND am.status=ANY($2::text[]))
   )
 ) evidence GROUP BY account_id) lc on lc.account_id = a.id
  where a.merged_into_id is null and a.archived_at is null and ($3 or a.deleted_at is null)
) as "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and (fecha_ultimo_contacto IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_activities ac WHERE ac.deleted_at IS NULL AND (ac.lead_id=leads.id OR (ac.lead_id IS NULL AND ac.account_id=leads.account_id)))) = $4 and greatest(coalesce(fecha_ultimo_contacto,created_at),coalesce((select max(occurred_at) from crm_activities ac where (ac.lead_id=leads.id or (ac.lead_id is null and ac.account_id=leads.account_id)) and ac.deleted_at is null),created_at)) < $5 and "fecha_proxima_accion" < $6 order by "account_id", "id" asc) as "leads" order by "fecha_creacion" desc, "id" desc limit $7 offset $8
